code_first.q: Trace linear search through an unsorted list of CPU register names.
code_first.code:
array registers = ["ACC","MDR","PC","MAR"]
for i = 0 to 3
    if registers[i] == "PC" then
        print(i)
    endif
next i
p: Change target "PC" to "MAR" and predict again.
Recall what PC and MAR store, and explain why linear search does not require a sorted list.
code_first.a: PC is at index 2; MAR is at index 3. PC holds the next instruction's address; MAR holds the memory address being accessed. Linear search can examine unsorted values in order. This small snippet prints nothing if there is no match; a full algorithm should report not found.
